articles.title: Man in his 50s injured in Scarborough stabbing
articles.summary: A man in his 50s has been injured following a stabbing in Scarborough, according to police. Officers were called to the Eglinton Avenue East and Markham Road area around 8:22 p.m. Tuesday for reports of a stabbing. articles.title: Dundas Street East closed after “serious” crash in Oakville
articles.summary: Halton police say a portion of Dundas Street East is closed in Oakville after a “serious” motor vehicle collision. Both eastbound and westbound lanes of Dundas Street East are closed between Postridge Drive and Eighth Line. There is no estimated time of when these lanes might reopen. articles.title: Pedestrian dead after being struck by pickup truck in hit and run in Mississauga, police say
articles.summary: A pedestrian is dead after being struck by a pickup truck in a hit and run in Mississauga on Tuesday evening, police say.

articles.title: Pedestrian killed in Mississauga hit-and-run, pickup truck driver outstanding: police
articles.summary: A pedestrian is dead after a hit-and-run in Mississauga on Tuesday evening, officials say. articles.title: Durham police get new helicopter as part of multimillion-dollar provincial program
articles.summary: Police in Durham Region have a new helicopter, Air4, as part of the province’s multimillion-dollar program to increase air support for Ontario police services.

articles.title: New York Gov. Hochul pushes for investigation into Cornell’s handling of a 2024 gang rape allegation
articles.summary: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul on Tuesday called for an investigation into Cornell University's response to a 2024 gang rape allegation in which a woman says she was sexually assaulted by seven students after being plied with alcohol and drugs.

articles.title: Ontario health-care coalition denounces province's plan to remove bike lanes across Toronto
articles.summary: A coalition of Ontario health-care workers gathered in downtown Toronto on Tuesday to denounce the provincial government’s plan to remove bike lanes on three major roadways across the city.

articles.title: 57-year-old man dead after cement truck rolls over on Highway 401 ramp in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: A 57-year-old man is dead after a cement truck rolled over on a Highway 401 ramp in Scarborough on Tuesday, police say.

articles.title: 2 people charged with 1st-degree murder in 2025 Vaughan killing: YRP
articles.summary: Two people have been charged in connection with the death of 41-year-old Deuvane Donald Francis in Vaughan, Ont, last summer.

articles.title: Crews clean up 2nd spill at Scarborough creek linked to subway extension work
articles.summary: Crews from the city and the province have cleaned up a second spill in Scarborough's West Highland Creek linked to work on a subway extension in the area.
